_histogram: The histogram is the EXACT live distribution from the widget (69 reviews, mean 4.7826 -> 4.78). The list below is the first page, 30 of 69, so the bars and the star filter tell the same story as the live widget will.

Bought the mallet putter and 56° wedge, do not regret at all. I was previously using a second hand putter and the difference is night and day, anything within 10 ft feels makable. I've never chipped in off the green this is a first and I'm a 25 handicap so I need all the luck I can get!
